answer_1.quote: We propose the task of text fact transfer, which aims to modify the factual content of a source text while preserving its style.
answer_1.outputs: generated target texts for text fact transfer

answer_2.quote: We measure the output similarity of the predicted and target texts with ROUGE-1/2 (R1/R2) and BLEU , serving as proxies for style preservation of the source text.
